wizard.templatePickerSubtitle: Pre-built research projects from common use cases. Pick one, then customize everything.
wizard.templateLoadError: Couldn't load templates. You can still start from scratch.
wizard.templateApplied: Template loaded — customize it as you like.
wizard.title: New research project
wizard.draftRestored: Draft restored — pick up where you left off.
wizard.confirmDiscardDraft: Discard this draft? Your work so far will be permanently deleted.
wizard.confirmDiscardForTemplates: Discard this draft and browse templates instead?
wizard.briefSubtitle: Tell us about your project so the AI can guide you through the rest.
wizard.contextPlaceholder: Describe your business and the problem you're trying to solve. The more specific your context, the more tailored the interview questions become.
wizard.summariseHint: AI reads your context and documents to extract the key points.
wizard.nameRequired: Enter a project name to continue
wizard.nameRequiredTooltip: Please enter a project name to continue
wizard.objectiveSubtitle: Define precisely what you want to learn. The AI will propose an objective based on your brief.
wizard.generateObjectiveHint: The AI drafts an objective from your brief. You can edit everything it writes.
wizard.objectivePlaceholder: e.g. Understand what leads first-time buyers to not return, and what would need to change for them to become regulars
wizard.decisionToInformLabel: What decision will this study inform?
wizard.decisionToInformPlaceholder: e.g. Should we prioritise building a mobile app next quarter, or invest in the web dashboard?
wizard.targetCustomerPlaceholder: e.g. UK-based product managers at Series A–C SaaS companies who have shipped research-driven features in the last 6 months
wizard.scopeSubtitle: Define who you're talking to and how long the interview should be.
wizard.generateScopeHint: The AI suggests audience and duration based on your objective.
wizard.audiencePlaceholder: e.g. remote workers, product managers, students…
wizard.screeningSubtitle: Optional — asked before the interview to filter participants. Mark answers that disqualify.
wizard.conversationStyleSubtitle: How the AI moderator opens and paces the interview.
wizard.warmupHelp: A low-stakes icebreaker before the real research questions. Recommended.
wizard.warmupSaveError: We couldn't save that. Please try again.
wizard.screeningQuestionPlaceholder: e.g. Do you shop online at least once a month?
wizard.confirmRemoveScreening: Remove this screening question? Participants will no longer be asked it.
wizard.questionsSubtitle: The AI will write a full guide based on your objective. You can edit, reorder, or add questions.
wizard.regenerateWarning: This will replace your {{count}} existing question(s). Your edits will be lost — consider copying any wording you want to keep.
wizard.generateGuideHint: The AI writes a full interview guide from your objective and learning goals. You can edit every question afterwards.
wizard.desiredLearningHint: — what insight this question aims to uncover
wizard.confirmRemoveQuestion: Remove this question from your guide?
wizard.errorParseBrief: We couldn't understand your brief. Try being more specific about the problem and who you're talking to, then try again.
wizard.errorObjective: We couldn't draft an objective from your brief. Add more detail about your research goals, then try again.
wizard.errorScope: We couldn't recommend a scope. Try again, or set it manually.
wizard.errorQuestions: We couldn't generate questions. Try again, or add questions manually.
wizard.errorCreate: We couldn't create your project. Please try again.
wizard.errorRefineQuestion: We couldn't refine that question. Please try again.
wizard.refineInstructionPlaceholder: Optional: how should we sharpen it? (e.g. more open-ended, shorter…)
wizard.refineScopeHint: Only this question will be rewritten. The rest of your guide stays untouched.
wizard.briefAndObjectiveSubtitle: Describe your project and define what you want to learn. The AI will help structure both.

detail.demoBannerText: This is a sample project to show you what QualiPulse can do. Ready to run your own study?
detail.unsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes in the Setup tab. Discard them?
detail.welcomeModalSubtitle: Share this link and start collecting responses — your first insights could be in as soon as an hour.
detail.proTip: The first 3 participants are the most valuable. Aim to recruit from inside your existing network — teammates, recent customers, or community members — rather than cold outreach.
detail.noAutoLink: We couldn't auto-generate an interview link. Head to the Overview tab to create one manually.
detail.editingFieldAria: Editing {{field}}. Press Enter to save or Escape to cancel.

setupLiveWarning.title: Edits go live immediately.

overview.creditGateTitle: Not enough credits to field this study

overview.creditGateBelowMin: Heads up: {{credits}} is below ~5, the minimum for reliable findings — topping up is the better call.
overview.creditGateLowered: Target set to {{credits}} — you can generate the link now.
